pages.brief: Night rain falling hard across the whole page in long silver diagonals, the oak a dark mass behind it. No characters. Atmospheric and wet.
pages.alt: Night rain falls hard across the whole page in long silver diagonals, the oak a dark mass behind it. No characters, just wet atmosphere.

pages.brief: Cutaway of the hollow in the oak: Nell and Olive tucked up dry inside, rain streaming past the opening. Warm inside, cold outside.
pages.alt: A cutaway of the hollow in the oak shows Nell and Olive tucked up dry inside while rain streams past the opening outside — warm inside, cold outside.

pages.brief: Close on a single leaf at the hollow's edge with rain running off it, and Nell's front leg reaching out into the drips. Cool blues and greens.
pages.alt: A close view of a single leaf at the hollow's edge with rain running off it, Nell reaching one front leg out into the drips.

pages.brief: The rain visibly thinning — fewer, finer lines, a pale gap opening in the cloud. Same composition as page one so the change reads.
pages.alt: The rain is visibly thinning now — fewer, finer lines — with a pale gap opening in the cloud, in the same view as the opening page.

pages.brief: The clouds parting to show a big bright moon, Olive's face lifting towards it, her amber eyes catching the light.
pages.alt: The clouds part to show a big bright moon, Olive's face lifting towards it, her amber eyes catching the light.

pages.brief: The moon drawn very large and pale, filling most of the page, the oak's bare top branches silhouetted across it.
pages.alt: The moon is drawn very large and pale, filling most of the page, with the oak's bare top branches silhouetted across it.

pages.brief: Olive in profile on her branch, entirely still, moonlight on her round plum-coloured back. Quiet and dignified.
pages.alt: Olive sits in profile on her branch, entirely still, moonlight on her round plum-coloured back. Quiet and dignified.

pages.brief: Closing page: Olive mid-hoot on the branch with Nell asleep in the crook below her. The whole wet garden shining in moonlight beneath them.
pages.alt: Closing page: Olive sits mid-hoot on the branch with Nell asleep in the crook below her, the whole wet garden shining in moonlight beneath them.
